name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to landholding farmer families (3 installments via DBT)
description_hi: भूमिधारी किसान परिवारों को वार्षिक ₹6,000 की आय सहायता (3 किस्तों में DBT)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary & tertiary hospitalization (cashless)
description_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक कैशलेस अस्पताल भर्ती कवर

name: MGNREGA
description: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per rural household (125 days proposed in 2025 Bill) + asset creation
description_hi: प्रति ग्रामीण परिवार 100 दिन गारंटीकृत रोजगार (2025 बिल में 125 दिन प्रस्तावित)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Housing assistance: PMAY-Gramin (rural pucca house + ₹1.2-1.3 lakh) & PMAY-Urban (interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh) for EWS/LIG/MIG
description_hi: आवास सहायता: PMAY-ग्रामीण (₹1.2-1.3 लाख) व PMAY-शहरी (₹2.67 लाख तक ब्याज सब्सिडी)

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, overdraft up to ₹10,000
description_hi: जीरो बैलेंस बैंक खाता, RuPay कार्ड, ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG connection + first refill & stove to BPL women, refill subsidy
description_hi: BPL महिलाओं को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन + पहला रिफिल व चूल्हा

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension ₹1,000-₹5,000 from age 60 for unorganized workers

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishor (₹50k-5L), Tarun (₹5-10L) extended to ₹20L in 2025 for micro-enterprises
description_hi: बिना गारंटी व्यापार ऋण: शिशु/किशोर/तरूण (₹50k-₹20 लाख)
benefits_hi: शिशु पर कोई प्रोसेसिंग फीस नहीं

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Girl child savings: 8.2% interest (2025), tax-free, for girl age 0-10, tenure 21 years
description_hi: बालिका बचत: 8.2% ब्याज, कर-मुक्त, 0-10 वर्ष की बालिका

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accident insurance: ₹2 lakh death/disability cover at ₹20/year premium (auto-debit)
description_hi: दुर्घटना बीमा: ₹20/वर्ष पर ₹2 लाख कवर

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance: ₹2 lakh cover at ₹436/year for natural & accidental death (18-50 years)
description_hi: जीवन बीमा: ₹436/वर्ष पर ₹2 लाख कवर (18-50 वर्ष)

name: E-Shram (Udyam & Unorganized Workers)
description: National database for unorganized workers: UAN card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance + priority in 12 welfare schemes
description_hi: असंगठित श्रमिकों के लिए राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस: UAN कार्ड, ₹2 लाख बीमा + 12 योजनाओं में प्राथमिकता
benefits: Priority in PM Awas, Ujjwala, Ayushman etc.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free 5 kg food grain per person per month to 80 crore NFSA beneficiaries (extended till Dec 2028)
description_hi: 80 करोड़ लाभार्थियों को प्रति व्यक्ति 5 किग्रा मुफ्त अनाज (दिसं 2028 तक)
benefits: One Nation One Ration Card portability

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance for farmers at low premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial) against natural calamities, pests & diseases
description_hi: कम प्रीमियम पर फसल बीमा - प्राकृतिक आपदा, कीट/रोग से सुरक्षा
benefits: Full sum insured on crop loss

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Pension ₹3,000/month from age 60 for small & marginal farmers (18-40 years, 2-hectare limit)
description_hi: 60 वर्ष से ₹3,000 मासिक पेंशन - छोटे/सीमांत किसानों के लिए

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Crop loan & working capital for farmers, fishermen & animal husbandry at 4% effective interest (with timely repayment) up to ₹3 lakh, with insurance cover
description_hi: किसानों/मछुआरों/पशुपालकों को ₹3 लाख तक 4% ब्याज पर फसल ऋण
benefits: Loan up to ₹3 lakh at 7% (4% on prompt repayment)

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Soil testing & nutrient advisory card every 2 years with fertilizer recommendations to improve yield and reduce cost
description_hi: हर 2 साल में मृदा परीक्षण और उर्वरक सिफारिश कार्ड

name: PM-KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
description: Solar pumps, grid-connected solar power plants & solarisation of grid pumps for farmers with 30-50% subsidy + loan support
description_hi: किसानों के लिए सोलर पंप, सोलर प्लांट व ग्रिड पंप सोलरीकरण पर 30-50% सब्सिडी
benefits: 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state) + 30% loan for solar pump

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
description: Rooftop solar subsidy up to ₹78,000 (up to 3 kW) + 300 units free electricity per month for 1 crore households
description_hi: रूफटॉप सोलर पर ₹78,000 तक सब्सिडी + 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली

name: UJALA (Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All)
description: Affordable LED bulbs, tube lights & fans distribution to reduce electricity bills (LED at ₹70, energy-efficient fans)
description_hi: सस्ते LED बल्ब, ट्यूब लाइट व पंखे वितरण - बिजली बिल कमी
benefits: Available at DISCOM counters & EESL outlets

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) Scheme
description: Hot cooked meal to 11.8 crore students in government & aided schools (Balvatika to Class 8), nutritional support + food security
description_hi: सरकारी/सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में 11.8 करोड़ छात्रों को गरम पका भोजन
benefits: Free hot cooked meal (450-700 calories, 12-20g protein)
Direct benefit transfer for cooking cost

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated scheme for school education (pre-school to Class 12): infrastructure, teacher training, inclusive education, uniforms & textbooks
description_hi: प्री-स्कूल से 12वीं तक समेकित स्कूली शिक्षा योजना
benefits: Support for CWSN (Children With Special Needs)

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Central Sector Schemes
description: One-stop portal for 100+ central scholarships (Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, Merit-cum-Means) for SC/ST/OBC/Minority/General students
description_hi: 100+ केंद्रीय छात्रवृत्तियों के लिए वन-स्टॉप पोर्टल

name: PM YASASVI (Young Achievers Scholarship Award)
description: Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT students Classes 9-12: ₹75k-125k per year plus hostel support, entrance exam based (YASASVI Entrance Test)
description_hi: OBC/EBC/DNT छात्रों (कक्षा 9-12) को ₹75k-125k छात्रवृत्ति

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: 100% central funding for SC students post Class 10: maintenance, tuition, books & compulsory fees (income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh)
description_hi: SC छात्रों को 10वीं के बाद 100% छात्रवृत्ति - ट्यूशन व भरण-पोषण

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme (SC/ST/OBC/Minority)
description: Scholarship for Classes 1-10 (SC/ST/OBC/Minority) with income limits, covering admission, tuition & maintenance
description_hi: कक्षा 1-10 के SC/ST/OBC/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

name: PM Vidya Lakshmi & Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS)
description: Education loans up to ₹10 lakh with interest subsidy & common portal (Vidya Lakshmi) for 40+ banks; PM-Vidya for collateral-free loans
description_hi: ₹10 लाख तक शिक्षा ऋण पर ब्याज सब्सिडी - 40+ बैंकों का कॉमन पोर्टल
benefits: Loan up to ₹10 lakh (₹7.5 lakh collateral-free)

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: Campaign + welfare for girl child: improve CSR, survival, education & prevent gender-biased sex selection; linked to Sukanya Samriddhi & scholarships
description_hi: बालिका सुरक्षा व शिक्षा हेतु अभियान - CSR सुधार, लिंग चयन रोकथाम
benefits: Linked to SSY & scholarships for girls

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit ₹5,000 in 2 installments + ₹1,000 under Janani Suraksha for first live birth (second child if girl gets ₹6,000)
description_hi: पहले जीवित जन्म पर ₹5,000 मातृत्व लाभ (दूसरा बच्चा लड़की तो ₹6,000)

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Cash assistance for institutional delivery: ₹600-₹1,400 for mothers + ASHA incentive to promote safe motherhood & reduce MMR/IMR
description_hi: संस्थागत प्रसव पर ₹600-₹1,400 नकद सहायता + आशा प्रोत्साहन
benefits: Free delivery & postnatal care under JSSK

name: Mission Indradhanush / Intensified MI 5.0
description: Full immunization for children 0-2 years & pregnant women left out or dropouts; 12 vaccine-preventable diseases covered, door-to-door
description_hi: 0-2 वर्ष के बच्चों व गर्भवती महिलाओं का पूर्ण टीकाकरण (12 रोग)
benefits: Free vaccines: BCG, OPV, DPT, Measles, Hepatitis B, etc.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Support for 18 traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter etc.): collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh, stipend ₹500/day, toolkit ₹15k, skill training & certificate
description_hi: 18 पारंपरिक कारीगरों को ₹3 लाख तक ऋण, ₹500 दैनिक भत्ता, ₹15k टूलकिट
benefits: Loan: ₹1 lakh (18m) + ₹2 lakh (30m) at 5% with guarantee

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Free short-term skill training (300+ job roles), certification & placement support + Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) with ₹8,000 reward
description_hi: 300+ जॉब रोल में मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण, प्रमाणन व प्लेसमेंट

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
name_hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना
description: Rural youth (15-35) skill & placement-linked program: free training, hostel, stipend up to ₹25k + post-placement support for BPL families
description_hi: ग्रामीण युवाओं (15-35) को मुफ्त आवासीय प्रशिक्षण व नौकरी लिंक

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy 15-35% (up to ₹50 lakh manufacturing / ₹20 lakh service) for micro-enterprises via KVIC/KVIB/DIC + EDP training
description_hi: सूक्ष्म उद्यमों को 15-35% सब्सिडी (₹50 लाख तक) + EDP प्रशिक्षण

name: Startup India Initiative
description: DPIIT recognition, tax exemption (80-IAC, Angel Tax), Fund of Funds (SISFS), BHASKARA, credit guarantee & self-certification for startups
description_hi: DPIIT मान्यता, कर छूट, फंड ऑफ फंड्स व क्रेडिट गारंटी
benefits: DPIIT recognition & IPR benefits (80% fee rebate)
SISFS seed fund up to ₹50 lakh

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans ₹10 lakh - ₹1 crore for SC/ST & women entrepreneurs (greenfield enterprises, manufacturing/services/trading)
description_hi: SC/ST व महिला उद्यमियों को ₹10 लाख - ₹1 करोड़ ऋण
benefits: Repayment up to 7 years + 18 months moratorium

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
description: SHG-based poverty reduction: livelihoods, financial inclusion, interest subvention (7% to 4% on prompt repayment), revolving fund ₹15k/SHG
description_hi: SHG आधारित गरीबी उन्मूलन - 7% ब्याज (समय पर 4%)
benefits: Revolving fund ₹15k/SHG, CIF up to ₹3 lakh/SHG
Bank linkage up to ₹20 lakh per SHG (without collateral)

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Working capital loans to street vendors: ₹15k (1st), ₹20k (2nd), ₹50k (3rd) at 7% interest subsidy + digital cashback up to ₹1,200/year
description_hi: रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों को ₹15k-₹50k कार्यशील ऋण, 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी
benefits: Cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions
Letter of Recommendation via ULB if no vending certificate

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Apprenticeship for youth (14-35) with stipend support: Govt shares 25% stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) + Basic Training Cost support
description_hi: युवाओं को अप्रेंटिसशिप - सरकार 25% वजीफा (₹1,500/माह तक) देती है
benefits: Stipend DBT share (25% up to ₹1,500) directly
Basic training cost up to ₹7,500 (500 hrs)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Central pension ₹200-300/month + state top-up (total ₹1,000-2,000) for BPL elderly 60+ ( ₹500 central for 80+)

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
description: Pension ₹300/month central (40-59 years) + state top-up for BPL widows 40-79; 80+ gets ₹500 central
description_hi: BPL विधवाओं (40-79) को ₹300 केंद्र + राज्य टॉप-अप

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना
description: Pension ₹300-500/month central for 80% disabled BPL persons (Dwarika replication) + state top-up; 80+ gets ₹500
description_hi: 80% दिव्यांग BPL व्यक्तियों को ₹300-500 केंद्र + राज्य टॉप-अप

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Pension ₹3,000/month from 60 for unorganized workers (18-40, income ≤ ₹15k/month) with 50:50 Govt contribution
description_hi: असंगठित श्रमिकों को 60 से ₹3,000 मासिक पेंशन (18-40 वर्ष)

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) & Senior Citizen Savings
description: Pension scheme for 60+ (8% assured return, ₹15 lakh cap, 10-year term via LIC) + SCSS 8.2% for seniors
description_hi: 60+ के लिए 8% सुनिश्चित रिटर्न पेंशन (₹15 लाख सीमा) + SCSS 8.2%
benefits: Loan after 3 years, premature exit for treatment
LIC administered (PMVVY closed 2023 but SCSS continues)

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons (ADIP) Scheme
description: Free aids & appliances (hearing aids, wheelchairs, prosthetics, Braille kits) to persons with disabilities (income ≤ ₹22,500/month for full cost)
description_hi: दिव्यांगजनों को मुफ्त सहायक उपकरण (हियरिंग एड, व्हीलचेयर आदि)
benefits: Aids: hearing aid, wheelchair, tricycle, Braille, artificial limbs
Travel & lodging for surgery if needed

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin & Urban 2.0)
description: Toilet incentive ₹12,000 (Gramin) + urban IHHL/CT/PT construction, solid waste management & ODF+ villages/cities
description_hi: शौचालय प्रोत्साहन ₹12,000 + शहरी/ग्रामीण स्वच्छता व कचरा प्रबंधन

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
name_hi: जल जीवन मिशन - हर घर जल
description: Functional household tap connection (55 lpcd) to every rural household by 2028; tap water quality testing & women-led Paani Samitis
description_hi: हर ग्रामीण घर में नल से जल (55 लीटर/व्यक्ति/दिन) - 2028 लक्ष्य
benefits: Water quality testing via FTK & labs
Community management via Village Water & Sanitation Committee

name: SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages & Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
description: Drone surveying + property cards (SVAMITVA cards) for inhabited rural areas to enable credit & reduce disputes
description_hi: ड्रोन सर्वे + ग्रामीण आबादी भूमि के लिए संपत्ति कार्ड

name: PM Van Dhan Yojana (Van Dhan Vikas Kendra)
description: Tribal MFP value addition: TRIFED support via VDVKs (15-20 members, 300 per cluster) with ₹15 lakh per 300-member cluster + MSP for MFP
description_hi: आदिवासी MFP मूल्य संवर्धन - प्रति 300 सदस्य क्लस्टर ₹15 लाख
benefits: ₹15 lakh per Van Dhan Kendra (300 tribals)

name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (PM Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan)
name_hi: धरती आबा जनजातीय ग्राम उत्कर्ष अभियान
description: Saturation of infrastructure (housing, roads, healthcare, education, electricity) in 63,000 tribal villages (2024-2029, ₹79,156 crore)
benefits: 25 interventions: housing (PMAY), tap water (JJM), mobile medical units
Hostels, Ashram schools, skill (PMKVY) + FRA support
Adopts PM PVTG Mission for 75 PVTG groups

name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
description: Residential schools (Class 6-12) for ST students in blocks with 20k+ tribals / 50% ST population; CBSE curriculum, free education + lodging
description_hi: ST छात्रों के लिए कक्षा 6-12 आवासीय विद्यालय - मुफ्त शिक्षा व आवास

name: National Fellowship & Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
name_hi: ST उच्च शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति व फेलोशिप
description: Top-Class education (₹7.5 lakh/year) + National Fellowship (750 ST scholars for MPhil/PhD) via DBT
description_hi: ST छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति (₹7.5 लाख/वर्ष) + फेलोशिप
benefits: National Fellowship for PhD: ₹31k-35k/month JRF/SRF + HRA

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
description: Create 14-digit ABHA (Health ID) + health facility/provider registry, Personal Health Records & consent-based sharing
description_hi: 14-अंकीय ABHA हेल्थ ID + हेल्थ रिकॉर्ड डिजिटलीकरण

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) + NFSA
name_hi: वन नेशन वन राशन कार्ड + NFSA
description: Portability of ration (NFSA 5 kg/person subsidized + PMGKAY free top-up + Antyodaya) across any FPS in India via Aadhaar seeding & ePoS
description_hi: आधार सीडिंग से किसी भी FPS पर राशन पोर्टेबिलिटी
benefits: NFSA: wheat ₹2/kg, rice ₹3/kg (now subsumed under PMGKAY free)

name: POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
description: Improve nutrition for children 0-6, pregnant women & lactating mothers: growth monitoring, take-home ration, counselling via Anganwadi / Poshan Tracker
description_hi: 0-6 वर्ष बच्चों, गर्भवती व धात्री महिलाओं के पोषण सुधार
benefits: Take-home ration & hot cooked meal via Anganwadi
Reduction targets: stunting, anaemia, low birth weight

name: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) / Anganwadi
description: 6 services: supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, immunization, health check-up, referral & nutrition education for 0-6 years & mothers
description_hi: 0-6 वर्ष व माताओं के लिए 6 सेवाएं - पोषण, टीकाकरण, प्री-स्कूल

name: PM eVIDYA (DIKSHA / SWAYAM / One Class One Channel)
description: Digital education: DIKSHA platform, 200 PM eVIDYA TV channels (Class 1-12), SWAYAM MOOCs & radio/podcasts for school & higher-ed
description_hi: डिजिटल शिक्षा - DIKSHA, 200 TV चैनल, SWAYAM MOOCs
benefits: SWAYAM: free courses + certification (fee for exam)

name: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) - Skill India Programme
description: Single digital platform for skilling, education, employment & entrepreneurship: NSDC courses, job exchange, eSkill India & Skill Loan
description_hi: कौशल, शिक्षा, रोजगार का सिंगल डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म
benefits: Skill loan up to ₹1.5 lakh (credit guarantee)

name: Atal Innovation Mission: Atal Tinkering Labs & AIC
description: Innovation labs in schools (ATL) + Atal Incubation Centres (AIC) + ANIC challenges; grant ₹20 lakh per ATL, ₹10 crore per AIC
description_hi: स्कूलों में अटल टिंकरिंग लैब (₹20 लाख) + इन्क्यूबेशन सेंटर

name: NAMO Drone Didi (Women SHG Drone Programme)
description: Drones to 15,000 women SHGs (2024-26) for agriculture rental services: 80% subsidy (up to ₹8 lakh) + training to women drone pilots
description_hi: 15,000 महिला SHGs को ड्रोन (80% सब्सिडी, ₹8 लाख तक) + महिला पायलट ट्रेनिंग
benefits: Fertilizer & pesticide spraying service to farmers

name: Lakhpati Didi Yojana (DAY-NRLM)
description: Enable 3 crore SHG Didis to earn ₹1 lakh+ annually via livelihood diversification, convergence & financial linkage (target 2026)
description_hi: 3 करोड़ SHG दीदियों को ₹1 लाख+ वार्षिक आय सक्षम करना
benefits: Convergence: MGNREGA, PM Awas, livestock, NRLM CIF
Drone Didi, Goat rearing, BC Sakhi etc. as pathways

name: National AYUSH Mission (NAM)
description: AYUSH healthcare: co-location of AYUSH in PHCs, AYUSH Health & Wellness Centres, essential drugs & medicinal plants promotion
description_hi: PHCs में आयुष सह-स्थान, वेलनेस सेंटर व औषधीय पौधे

name: PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks
description: 7 integrated textile parks (PPP, ₹4,445 crore) with plug-and-play infra, 1 lakh direct + 2 lakh indirect jobs per park
description_hi: 7 एकीकृत टेक्सटाइल पार्क - प्लग-एंड-प्ले अवसंरचना, प्रति पार्क 1 लाख नौकरी
benefits: Capital support up to ₹500 crore/park (30% central)

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
name_hi: CGTMSE - सूक्ष्म व लघु उद्यम क्रेडिट गारंटी
description: Collateral-free credit guarantee up to ₹5 crore (85% for micro, 75% for others) for MSEs via guarantee cover fee 0.37-1.35%
description_hi: MSEs को ₹5 करोड़ तक बिना गारंटी क्रेडिट गारंटी (85%/75%)
benefits: Guarantee up to ₹5 crore (85% micro, 75% others; 80% women/NE/SC-ST)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
description: 1 crore urban houses (2024-29) for EWS/LIG/MIG: Beneficiary Led Construction (₹2.5 lakh), AHP (₹2.5 lakh/unit), Rental Housing & ISS (up to ₹1.8 lakh)
description_hi: 1 करोड़ शहरी आवास (2024-29) - ₹2.5 लाख सहायता + किराया आवास
benefits: Interest subsidy (ISS) up to ₹1.8 lakh for EWS/LIG/MIG (via PLI)
documents_required_hi: कोई पक्का मकान नहीं शपथ पत्र

name: Atal Bhujal Yojana (Atal Jal)
description: Community-led groundwater management in 8,200 Gram Panchayats across 7 states (prioritized over-exploited blocks) with incentive fund
description_hi: 7 राज्यों के 8,200 पंचायतों में समुदाय-नेतृत्व भूजल प्रबंधन

name: Per Drop More Crop (PMKSY - Micro Irrigation)
name_hi: पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप (PMKSY सूक्ष्म सिंचाई)
description: Micro-irrigation subsidy: 55% small/marginal, 45% other farmers for drip/sprinkler; additional state top-up to 70-80%
description_hi: ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर पर 55% छोटे/सीमांत, 45% अन्य किसानों को सब्सिडी
benefits: Drip/sprinkler subsidy 45-55% (up to 80% with state top-up)
Linked to Soil Health & crop advisory

name: Mission Shakti (Sambal - One Stop Centre, Sakhi & Samarthya - PMMVY, Hostel etc.)
description: Umbrella women safety & empowerment: OSC (Sakhi) One Stop Centres (770+), Women Helpline 181, Shakti Sadan, Palna (crèche), Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana etc.
description_hi: महिला सुरक्षा व सशक्तिकरण अम्ब्रेला - वन स्टॉप सेंटर, 181 हेल्पलाइन
benefits: One Stop Centre: medical, legal, psycho-social, police facilitation (24x7)
Shakti Sadan & Sakhi Niwas (working women hostel)
Palna crèche (50% fee support) + PMMVY convergence

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Farm machinery subsidy 40-50% (up to 80% for CHCs/FPOs) + Custom Hiring Centres & Farm Machinery Banks for small farmers
description_hi: कृषि मशीनरी पर 40-50% सब्सिडी (CHC/FPO को 80% तक)
benefits: CHC project up to ₹60 lakh (40% subsidy)
Tractor, power tiller, drone, harvester etc.
Training at Farm Machinery Training Institutes

name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) - Antyodaya & Priority Households
description: 67% population coverage: Antyodaya 35 kg/household free + Priority 5 kg/person free (via PMGKAY subsumes cost) through Fair Price Shops
description_hi: 67% आबादी कवर - अंत्योदय 35 किग्रा/परिवार + प्राथमिकता 5 किग्रा/व्यक्ति मुफ्त
benefits: Antyodaya: 35 kg/HH free (rice/wheat/coarse grain + 1 kg sugar)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Fisheries infra: 60% subsidy (SC/ST/Women) / 40% (General) for ponds, cages, hatcheries, boats, cold chain & insurance; ₹20,050 crore outlay
description_hi: मत्स्य अवसंरचना पर 60% (SC/ST/महिला) / 40% (सामान्य) सब्सिडी
benefits: Subsidy 40-60% + bank loan (60% bank, remainder subsidy)
Cage culture, RAS, biofloc, seaweed support

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF) & National Livestock Mission
name_hi: पशुपालन अवसंरचना विकास निधि व राष्ट्रीय पशुधन मिशन
description: Dairy, meat, feed & breed infra: 3% interest subvention + 90% loan (up to ₹50 crore) + entrepreneurship for breed improvement, fodder & insurance
description_hi: डेयरी, चारा, नस्ल सुधार पर 3% ब्याज सब्सिडी + 90% ऋण

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
name_hi: पीएम सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम औपचारिकीकरण
description: Micro food entrepreneurs & SHGs: 35% credit-linked subsidy (up to ₹10 lakh) + seed capital ₹40k/SHG, ODOP, training via SIs & branding
description_hi: सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्यमियों को 35% सब्सिडी (₹10 लाख तक) + ₹40k SHG सीड पूंजी
benefits: Seed capital ₹40k per SHG member for working capital
Training & handholding via District Resource Persons

name: PM-Unnati / PM Suraj? Actually PM Suraj, PM VAni etc. Placeholder: PM Youth Internship & Apprenticeship
description: Internship in top 500 companies for youth 21-24: ₹5,000/month (₹4,500 Govt + ₹500 company) + ₹6,000 one-time grant, 12 months, 1 crore internships (5 years)
benefits: Certificate & employability boost (no permanent job guarantee)
documents_required: Education certificate (10th+; not graduate from elite institutions)

name: PM-eBus Sewa & PM Electric Drive (PM E-Drive) - FAME successor
name_hi: पीएम ई-बस सेवा व पीएम ई-ड्राइव
description: E-mobility: 10,000 e-buses in 169 cities + e-2W/e-3W/e-truck subsidies via PM E-Drive (₹10,900 crore, 2024-26) replacing FAME-II
benefits: e-2W subsidy up to ₹10k, e-3W, e-truck, e-ambulance support

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
description: Urban poor skilling (ESTP), SHG bank linkage (interest 7% → 4% subvention), street vendor & shelter (SM) support
description_hi: शहरी गरीबों को कौशल, SHG बैंक लिंकेज (4% ब्याज) व आश्रय
benefits: ESTP skill training + placement + ₹3,000 post-placement (6 months)
Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH) & SM for infrastructure vendors

name: AMRUT 2.0 (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)
description: Urban water supply & sewerage: universal tap + sewer coverage in 500 cities (4,700 ULBs under 2.0) + Pey Jal Survekshan & green parks
description_hi: 500 शहरों में सर्व-व्यापी नल व सीवर कवरेज + हरित पार्क
benefits: 137 acre green parks + water bodies rejuvenation
Pey Jal Survekshan for competitive improvement

name: Smart Cities Mission
description: 100 cities: area-based (retrofit/redevelop/greenfield) + pan-city ICT solutions (ICCC, smart utilities, mobility & housing)
description_hi: 100 शहरों में क्षेत्र-आधारित व पैन-सिटी ICT समाधान
benefits: Smart roads, water, waste, mobility, housing
SPV-led project execution (now transitioning to state ownership 2025)

name: BharatNet (Digital India - Rural Broadband)
description: Broadband to 2.5 lakh+ Gram Panchayats via OFC, satellite & PM-WANI WiFi; BharatNet Udyami model (2023) for village-level entrepreneurs
description_hi: 2.5 लाख+ ग्राम पंचायतों को OFC/सैटेलाइट से ब्रॉडबैंड
benefits: GP-level OFC connectivity (100 Mbps scalable to 1 Gbps)
FTTH to households via local entrepreneurs (Udyami)

name: PM-WANI (Wi-Fi Access Network Interface)
description: Public WiFi via PDO (no license/fee): 1M+ hotspots target, cheap data (₹2-20 for short plans), interoperable via WANI app & C-DoT central registry
description_hi: PDO के जरिए सार्वजनिक WiFi (बिना लाइसेंस/फीस) - ₹2-20 प्लान
benefits: Become PDO (tea shop, kirana) without license
Enables UPI, education, DBT in rural

name: PM Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
description: Digital literacy to 6 crore rural households (1 per HH): basic operations, internet, email, payments, e-Gov (20-hour training via CSCs)
description_hi: 6 करोड़ ग्रामीण परिवारों (प्रति परिवार 1) को 20 घंटे डिजिटल साक्षरता

name: Niramaya Health Insurance (NTrust - for disabilities, via National Trust)
description: ₹1 lakh health cover for persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation & Multiple Disabilities (PwDs under National Trust) at low premium (BPL reimbursed)
description_hi: ऑटिज्म, सेरेब्रल पाल्सी आदि दिव्यांगजनों को ₹1 लाख स्वास्थ्य कवर
benefits: Cover ₹1 lakh (hospitalization, surgery, therapy, pre/post hospitalization)
documents_required: Disability certificate (National Trust disabilities: Autism, CP, MR, MD)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: OBC post-Class 10 scholarship (income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh, now ₹1.5 lakh? enhanced in 2023) covering maintenance, tuition & fees via DBT
description_hi: OBC छात्रों को 10वीं के बाद पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minority Students (via NSP)
description: Minority students in technical/professional courses (income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh, 50% marks): course fee up to ₹20k/year + maintenance ₹10k (hostel) / ₹5k (day)
description_hi: अल्पसंख्यक तकनीकी/व्यावसायिक छात्रों को ₹20k फीस + ₹10k भत्ता

name: Top Class Education for SC Students
name_hi: SC छात्रों के लिए टॉप क्लास शिक्षा
description: SC students admitted in NIRF-ranked IITs/IIMs/ IIT etc. + premier institutions: full academic fee + living, books, computer allowance
description_hi: SC छात्रों को NIRF/IIT/IIM आदि में पूरी फीस + भत्ता
benefits: Full tuition + non-refundable charges (up to ₹2-3 lakh)
12 top institutes annually per state quota

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
description: 1 lakh scholarships ₹12,000/year for Class 9-12 students of economically weaker (parent income ≤ ₹3.5 lakh, Class 8 merit exam via SCERT)

name: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Wards of Ex-Servicemen & CAPF
description: 5500 scholarships: ₹30k/year for boys, ₹36k for girls (60%+ in 10+2, professional courses, 4-5 years) from National Defence Fund & CAPF fund
description_hi: भूतपूर्व सैनिक/CAPF आश्रितों को 5500 छात्रवृत्ति: लड़के ₹30k, लड़कियां ₹36k
benefits: Paid for full course duration (up to 5 years)

name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP)
description: Flagship Ministry of Textiles scheme for weavers: cluster development (Block Level Clusters & handloom clusters), marketing assistance, design & technology upgradation, skill training via Weaver Service Centres (WSCs)
description_hi: बुनकरों के लिए प्रमुख योजना - क्लस्टर विकास, विपणन सहायता, डिजाइन व कौशल प्रशिक्षण
benefits: Block Level Cluster: ₹2 crore support (loom, workshed, lighting)
Marketing: 15% incentive + Handloom Haat/Bazaar, e-commerce onboarding (IndiaHandloom)
Design intervention (WSC designers) + skill training with stipend ₹300-500/day

name: Yarn Supply Scheme (YSS) / Raw Material Supply Scheme (RMSS)
description: NHDC-mediated yarn at Mill Gate Price: 10% price subsidy (cotton, silk, wool, linen) + freight reimbursement + depot + 2% service charge waiver for handloom weavers & cooperatives
description_hi: NHDC के जरिए मिल गेट मूल्य पर यार्न - 10% सब्सिडी + भाड़ा प्रतिपूर्ति + डिपो
benefits: Yarn at Mill Gate Price (no trader margin)
10% price subsidy (all yarn types) + 10% extra for indigent (Antyodaya) weavers
Freight reimbursement + depot operating support (NHDC, yarn depots)
Pahchan card-linked indent via e-Dhaga portal (online)

name: Comprehensive Handloom Cluster Development Scheme (CHCDS) & Mega Handloom Cluster
name_hi: समग्र हथकरघा क्लस्टर विकास योजना व मेगा क्लस्टर
description: Integrated development of handloom clusters with end-to-end support: 2 Mega clusters (Varanasi, Sivasagar) + 8 large clusters (15,000-25,000 looms) + block clusters; funding up to ₹40 crore per mega cluster
description_hi: हथकरघा क्लस्टरों का एकीकृत विकास - 2 मेगा + 8 बड़े क्लस्टर, प्रति मेगा ₹40 करोड़
benefits: Mega cluster up to ₹40 crore (CFC, design, skill, marketing, raw material depot)
Common Facility Centre (dyeing, warping, testing, warehousing)
Upgradation of looms & accessories (jacquard, dobby, frame loom)
Brand building, GI registration, export facilitation (HEPC)
documents_required: DPR via State Handloom Dept / WSC

name: Weaver MUDRA Scheme / Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata (HSS)
name_hi: बुनकर मुद्रा योजना / हथकरघा संवर्धन सहायता
description: Concessional credit to handloom weavers: MUDRA loan up to ₹10 lakh + margin money 90% subsidy for workshed, loom & margin; interest subvention 6% + credit guarantee fee borne by Govt
description_hi: बुनकरों को रियायती ऋण - ₹10 लाख तक मुद्रा + 90% मार्जिन मनी + 6% ब्याज सब्सिडी
benefits: Loan up to ₹10 lakh (MUDRA: Shishu/Kishor/Tarun) at 6% subvention (effective ~7% after guarantee)
Margin money: 90% Govt (HSS) for individual, 100% for SC/ST/Women cooperatives
Credit guarantee (CGTMSE) fee paid by Govt + Mudra card + online via handloom parity portal

name: Handloom Weavers' Comprehensive Welfare Scheme (HWCWS) - Insurance & Health Converged
name_hi: हथकरघा बुनकर व्यापक कल्याण योजना - बीमा व स्वास्थ्य
description: Life & health cover for weavers: converged to PMJJBY (₹2 lakh life at ₹436) + PMSBY (₹2 lakh accident at ₹20) + converged Ayushman/AB-PMJAY referral via WSC; scholarship for weaver children (Pre-Matric/Post-Matric via NSP)
description_hi: बुनकरों के लिए जीवन/दुर्घटना/स्वास्थ्य कवर - PMJJBY/PMSBY + आयुष्मान अभिसरण + छात्रवृत्ति
benefits: PMJJBY ₹2 lakh (₹436/yr) + PMSBY ₹2 lakh (₹20/yr) premium now converged (Govt pays for BPL weavers in some states)
Health converged to Ayushman PM-JAY (₹5 lakh) + WSC health camps
Scholarship via NSP (Pre/Post-Matric for weaver wards, ₹1k-2k/month)
Awareness camps via WSC & State Handloom Depts

name: Handloom Mark Scheme & India Handloom Brand (IHBB) + Marketing Assistance
name_hi: हैंडलूम मार्क व इंडिया हैंडलूम ब्रांड + विपणन सहायता
description: Authenticity & branding: Handloom Mark (99+ categories) + India Handloom Brand (premium quality certification by Textiles Committee) + marketing events (National Handloom Day 7 Aug, Dilli Haat, Gandhi Shilp Bazaar) + e-commerce (handloom bazaar, GeM, ONDC)
description_hi: प्रामाणिकता व ब्रांडिंग - हैंडलूम मार्क + इंडिया हैंडलूम ब्रांड + विपणन मेले व GeM/ONDC
benefits: Handloom Mark labels + India Handloom Brand certification (testing at Textiles Committee labs)
Participation subsidy: stall rent, TA/DA for fairs (Dilli Haat, IITF, regional expos) + 10% sales rebate (NHDP)
GeM onboarding, ONDC, handloombazaar.gov.in & Flipkart/Amazon Weaves
GI tagging support (e.g., Banarasi, Kanchipuram) + design trademark
documents_required: GST (for Brand) + product samples for testing
